focus: The oracle just got more personal: if you've played one of our games, IGNIS now greets you with questions tailored to that game. First-time visitors get curated starter questions to help break the ice. Push notifications now track delivery and clicks so we know what's reaching you.
nextStep: Coming soon: segmented push notifications (send to players of a specific game only), and a forge devlog from the studio on what's building this month.
